answer: The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, split across independent auditors, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work. What survives to the mirror is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. A pigment of per-task receipts records who did what, and the timber of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work.
